title: Maximal square
statement: In a grid of '0'/'1', return the area of the largest square containing only '1's.
hints: Let dp[i][j] be the side of the largest all-1 square whose bottom-right corner is (i, j).
It is limited by the squares ending above, to the left, and diagonally up-left.

solution.explanation: The state is anchored at a corner: dp = 1 + min(up, left, up-left). The square can't extend further than the smallest of the three neighbouring squares allows, and it can extend that far. Choosing an anchored state ("ending at", "with corner at") is the key DP move for substructures inside grids and strings.
